evidence.title: A Kantian Critique of "Sorry" by Justin Bieber

summary: A new AI system has produced a philosophical analysis of Justin Bieber’s hit song “Sorry” through a Kantian lens, showcasing the model’s ability to apply complex ethical frameworks to pop culture. The demonstration highlights advances in natural‑language understanding and the potential for AI to engage in nuanced academic discourse.
title: AI Generates Kantian Critique of Justin Bieber’s “Sorry”
